description: This file defines the LinkDecoder interface with two anonymous class implementations for decoding data packets, one for text protocol and one for void, related to communication protocols in the project.

classes.name: LinkDecoder
classes.description: An interface for decoding data packets, with two predefined implementations for different protocol types.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Converts a data packet string into a decoded form, implementation varies between the interface's anonymous classes.
